notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard transportation reports and confirmations. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies attribute and interaction transportation queries and change confirmations, suppression and release of all four callback forms, exact object/class/attribute/federate and transportation metadata, committed transportation state, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with query/request attribute and interaction transportation services and FederateAmbassador transportation report/confirmation delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and transportation declarations
